name: nadlan
description: Nadlan — React client and NestJS API
author: Itay Schmidt

scripts.dev: node server/scripts/check-node.mjs && npm run db && npm-run-all --parallel dev:server dev:client
scripts.dev:client: node scripts/wait-for-server.mjs && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: node server/scripts/check-node.mjs && npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.lint: cd server && npm run lint && cd ../client && npm run lint
